E39.statement: The declared q<=8 corpus, exact envelopes, synthetic profiles, alignment obstruction, and mandatory controls are independently reproducible.

EXT17.statement: Matveev's explicit real two-logarithm theorem gives the recorded fixed-2,3 multiplicative lower bound.

H133.statement: Asymptotic area and support growth do not exclude arbitrary-area primitive positive cycles.

NG36.statement: Least-value and discrepancy-minimum rotations universally coincide for positive rational affine cycles.

P162.statement: A polynomial lower bound on lambda(1-lambda) forces liminf A_*/q^(2/3)>=((log_2 3)^2/2)^(1/3).

P163.statement: The noncritical positive-cycle branch has an internal polynomial multiplier gap and therefore the P162 area dispersion.

P164.statement: Using EXT17 on the critical branch, every primitive positive nontrivial cycle sequence has the P162 area liminf.

P165.statement: Arbitrary-gcd support controls Hamming complexity, h_*<=s_*, and polynomial gap forces liminf s_*/sqrt(q)>=sqrt(log_2 3/2); P163/P164 make this global for positive cycles.

polynomial_gap_area.hypothesis: lambda*(1-lambda)>=c*q^(-kappa) with fixed c>0 and kappa>=0

rotation_boundary: P133 uses a least-value rotation; P156 uses a discrepancy-minimum rotation. They cannot be identified without an additional theorem.

structural_phase_diagram.diffuse: h_*=o(q^(1/3)), so area of order q^(2/3) must be spread over many lower defects
structural_phase_diagram.status: strategy split only; neither branch is excluded
structural_phase_diagram.tall: h_* comparable to or above q^(1/3), forcing a descent through every level and valuation-one transitions at baseline-2 positions

what_this_result_does_not_prove: No area is excluded asymptotically, neither tall nor diffuse profiles are eliminated, positive-integral rotation alignment is open, and Collatz is not proved.
